payload.title: Restore Andreas self-hosted runner and finish ClayCode BASE14
payload.work_clay: On the owner-registered Andreas Ubuntu target, pull current main into a clean checkout. Run: bash tools/claycode_bootstrap_andreas_self_hosted_runner.sh . This script must first verify the registered machine fingerprint, Ubuntu/x86_64/non-container status and authenticated gh access; then it may provision/start the repository-scoped GitHub Actions runner. Do not bypass those guards. Once the runner is online, the already queued self-hosted jobs should be consumed automatically. If not, execute directly from the clean checkout with GitHub Actions transport variables absent: python3 tools/claycode_run_andreas_target_acceptance.py . Preserve all failing receipts. Repair only concrete implementation/orchestration defects; never weaken target identity, real desktop, Full-FRANK, authority, real-app, WP14 or P0/P1 gates. Finish only after remote GitHub reread shows the independent WP14 manifest PASS, 14/14 ClayCode work packages PASS and 10/10 real apps PASS.
payload.reason_clay: Observable PR diagnostics proved hosted GitHub jobs currently fail before step 1, while a self-hosted [linux,x64] availability job remains queued. The remaining release blocker is therefore physical runner availability/target execution transport, not a known unresolved ClayCode language counterexample.
payload.completion_clay: PASS only when a matching repository self-hosted runner is online, the canonical target acceptance exits 0 on the registered Andreas Ubuntu host, APP05 real Ubuntu desktop is mapped and independently audited, Full-FRANK H1/H2/H3 passes, ten per-app target receipts pass, ANDREAS_UBUNTU_BASE_ACCEPTANCE_STRICT overall_pass=true, CLAYCODE_GENERAL_PURPOSE_COMPILER_MANIFEST general_purpose_gate_pass=true and claycode_release_gate_pass=true with failed_work_packages=[], and CLAYCODE_RELEASE_WORKSPACE is BASE_PASS with every CC-WP-01..14 status=PASS.
